services.description: Zero-downtime migration from AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-premise infrastructure with dedicated architect oversight.

services.name: Automated DevOps & CI/CD
services.description: Production-ready GitOps deployment pipelines, container orchestration, and automated canary deployments.

services.name: Enterprise Security & SOC-2 Auditing
services.description: Continuous vulnerability scanning, TLS 1.3 encryption, SOC-2 Type II audit logs, and DDoS mitigation.

services.name: Global Disaster Recovery & Replication
services.description: Active-active multi-region replication ensuring sub-minute RTO and high fault tolerance against outages.

faqs.question: What is your refund and return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all subscription plans. If you are not satisfied within the first 30 days of service, contact support for a 100% full refund.

faqs.question: How long does deployment and setup take?
faqs.answer: Starter and Pro plans deploy instantly within 5 to 10 minutes. Custom Enterprise setups typically take 1 to 2 business days with our assisted onboarding team.

faqs.question: Where is my data stored and is it secure?
faqs.answer: All data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. We are SOC-2 Type II certified and host data in ISO-compliant regional data centers.

faqs.question: How can I contact human customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach our human support team directly via email at support@apexsolutions.demo or call us at +1 (800) 555-APEX during business hours.
